title: The Hen in the Hut
lines: Tom has a hen. It is his pet.
The hen hid in a hut.
Tom got in the hut. Tom did dig.
The hen hid in his hat!
Tom did not get it. Dad did.
Dad got the hat. The hen got up.

questions.listenFor: In Tom's hat, right on his head. The story says it. If your child says the hut, read the line about the hat again together.
Dad. Listen for Dad, not Tom - Tom looked everywhere but could not see his own hat.

questions.ask: Why do you think the hen picked the hat? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine - it was warm, it was soft, it was a good hiding spot. You are listening for a reason, not a right answer.
